facts.fact: The World Bank reports that Burundi Backbone System (BBS) has one level-3 data center, built at a cost of USD 2 million, which it uses to offer hosting to customers and which other public agencies use to back up their systems; the report gives no opening date, so as_of is the report's 2020 publication date.

systems.tiers: level-3 (not stated as Uptime or TIA-942)

systems.system: Ministry of Health data center (PNDIS II plan)

note: Only the BBS data center is a data centre for hire; 'level-3' is not tied to a Tier III standard, so no tier3 fact is recorded.
